research_question: Conditional on receiving a stock-exchange inquiry, does higher regulatory response quality predict less subsequent accrual-based earnings management?

rri_sample.rri_year: calendar year of first substantive response after current source repair

peer_estimation.universe: all A-share nonfinancial firm-years available from the public full financial panel
peer_estimation.fiscal_years_needed: 2013-2025 raw annual data; DA estimated for 2014-2025
peer_estimation.continuous_ratio_winsorization: 1st/99th percentiles within fiscal year before peer regression

field_policy.PPE_rule: must use a direct fixed-assets/PPE field from the public full historical financial source; do not drop PPE and do not create a proxy after seeing results
field_policy.annual_record: fiscal year end 12-31; latest final/announcement version within stock-year where duplicate versions exist

industry_policy.fallback: same-firm nearest historical industry within +/-1 year, prior year first; unresolved remains UNKNOWN

main_regression.equation: ABS_DA_(t+1) = alpha + beta*RRI10_t + rho*ABS_DA_(t-1) + Size_t + Leverage_t + ROA_t + SalesGrowth_t + Cash_t + ln(1+nQuestions_t) + YearFE + IndustryFE + InquiryTypeFE + error
main_regression.primary_sample: nonfinancial RRI firm-years with valid ABS_DA_(t-1), ABS_DA_(t+1), and t controls

prespecified_robustness.first_event_only: keep earliest RRI firm-year per firm
prespecified_robustness.signed_DA: descriptive/secondary only; cannot rescue failed ABS_DA primary

decision_rule.otherwise: NO-GO for AEM mainline; do not change peer N, Modified Jones equation, winsorization, controls, or RRI aggregation to rescue significance
